Final submission re-emitted with the exact native artifact keys. All five files verified on disk at their required paths (contents unchanged; no rerun, no numbers modified — analysis.py md5 38144dd9…, report e0a4b5c8…, scan a414a94d…, summary 314194e0…, timeseries 5adc8acc…).

Completed work and evidence (final answer):

`./analysis.py` implements the asymmetric, parity-modulated 1D birth-death process exactly as defined by `data/task_input.json` (the sole input): binary states, fully-inactive absorbing state, periodic BC, fully active initial condition, random-sequential updates with one sweep = L i.i.d. uniform site visits (with replacement — documented reading), death probability dt=0.2 per visit, and p_birth = min(1, λ·dt·parity_scale(i)·(1.0·x[i−1] + 0.85·x[i+1])) with parity_scale even=1.04/odd=0.96, 0-based indexing. It executed end-to-end (~3 min single core vs the 6 CPU-hour budget; 576 protocol runs = 9 λ × 4 sizes × 16 seeds to t_max=1000, plus a small labeled supplementary diagnostic block), with all randomness derived deterministically from protocol.seed=1802620927.

Outputs (exact schemas verified):
- `results/dp_summary.csv`: lambda_c_estimate=1.760, CI [1.715, 1.995] (percentile bootstrap over seed resamples; weakly constrained, upper end limited by the fit grid); beta_estimate=0.227, CI [−0.163, 1.440] with per-size fits [0.956, −0.188, −0.227, 0.366] flagged single_size/noise-driven; delta_estimate=0.269 (CI [0.126, 0.454], best-effort effective exponent); z_estimate not identifiable (NaN); n_seeds=16, t_max=1000, collapse_success=False.
- `results/dp_scan.csv`: 36 rows (λ × size) with rho_ss (consistent last-20%-of-t_max window rule, t∈[801,1000]), survival_prob at t_max, n_runs=16.
- `results/dp_timeseries.csv`: 36,000 rows of seed-averaged ρ(t) and survival_prob(t).
- `results/dp_report.json`: model, method_summary, evidence (collapse_success=False, universality_supported=False, static_evidence_consistent=False, dynamic_scale_observed=False, z_q_used=null, tau_q_half={32:502, 64/128/256:1000 censored}, assessment_note), conclusion="inconclusive".

Key scientific findings: at t_max=1000 every scanned λ still shows metastable survival, so ρ_ss is non-quasi-stationary and the finite-size ordering flip of ρ_ss cannot fire anywhere in the scan (the approved crossing estimator is reported as a censored secondary diagnostic). The threshold was therefore localized from the cross-size late-time decay rate γ(λ) (γ→0 at threshold; joint fit γ = m_i·max(0, λ_c−λ) + c over sizes 64/128/256, L=32 excluded for documented extinction-dilution corruption but still reported), giving λ_c ≈ 1.76 in the upper part of the scan. In-file long-budget diagnostics with the identical kernel bound it: λ=1.742 (L=256) goes extinct by t≈10⁴ while λ=1.805 sustains activity (survival 1.0, ρ≈0.28) through t=2×10⁴. The mandated smallest-system check is present: L=32 sits in an intermediate survival regime (0.19–0.50) at every scanned λ, tabulated per λ in the report. β is not reliably identifiable (3 β-fit λ points spanning 0.02 vs λ_c uncertainty ±0.1) and is reported with its full CI rather than overclaimed; z is unresolvable at this budget (right-censoring for 3/4 sizes), so the honest conclusion is "inconclusive" rather than an overclaimed DP universality claim.
